name: playpi
description: Pi extensions playground. Ships extensions/zen - a presentation-layer toggle that shows results only (thinking, tool rows and non-final assistant messages hidden), with an animated fish working indicator - and extensions/token-rate - a statusline extension that publishes the latest assistant message's output tokens/s and cache-hit rate via ctx.ui.setStatus() without taking over the footer.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --strict --target es2022 --lib es2023 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --allowImportingTsExtensions --skipLibCheck --types node extensions/zen/index.ts extensions/token-rate/index.ts extensions/minimal-footer/index.ts extensions/token-rate/lib/token-rate.test.ts
